messages.subject: Anyone has used 'rjags' package in your shiny project?
parts:
I`ve tried to bulid an web server monitoring forest fires. Specifically, I wish to fit a Bayesian hierarchical model to show the probabilities of regions. 

 I did fit a lot of bayes models in R project when I studied in college, but totally new to this kind of web server project.

 I know that the 'rjags' package is needed, but I wonder whether the package could be available in shiny application.

 please give me advise, it would be very helpful to me.
